environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the 'side-neck' anatomy; gentle, slow-moving character energy; quadrants should feel interconnected by the river environment.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left (Birth): A small hatchling turtle digging its way out of a sandy riverbank, with the sun low on the horizon; Top-Right (Dining): The turtle underwater, snapping its jaws at a small freshwater crustacean near a mossy rock; Bottom-Left (Sleeping): The turtle pulled partially into its shell, resting at the bottom of a shallow pool, surrounded by gently waving water weeds; Bottom-Right (Playing/Basking): A 'stack' of three turtles of different sizes basking on a half-submerged log, soaking up the afternoon sun.
visual_logic.ground: Varies from gritty, sun-warmed sand to the slippery, algae-covered wood of a fallen tree.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, golden-hour lighting that emphasizes the textures of the shells and the sparkling ripples of the river water.
